hero.heading: Blinds & Window Treatments in Boulder City, NV
hero.intro: A good blind or shade changes how a room feels: soft light in the morning, real privacy at night, no gap of exposed glass staring back at the street. We measure every window by hand and build to that exact opening, so nothing looks stretched or bought off a shelf, with roller, cellular and Roman shades and motorized options for windows nobody wants to reach by a step stool. Family owned since 1994, we install for homes and businesses across Boulder City, Henderson and Las Vegas.

content.heading: Blinds & Window Treatments
content.intro: Expertly installed blinds and soft window treatments for homes and businesses across Clark County, sized for the Nevada climate.
content.note: New blinds and shades are what we install. If something you already own needs fixing and you are not sure where to start, call us anyway and we will help you work out the right next step.
bullets: Professional install, and we fix what is not right

shades.heading: Find the Right Window Treatment
shades.sub: Every room handles light differently. We help you pick the treatment that fits the space, then build it to fit your windows.

cards.alt: Roller shades lowered across a dining room window wall
cards.title: Roller Shades
cards.text: Clean and simple. A smooth fabric panel rolls away for the full view and drops for instant privacy. A great fit for living areas and offices.

cards.alt: Cellular honeycomb shades on a bright living room window
cards.title: Cellular Shades
cards.text: Honeycomb cells trap a layer of air at the glass, helping insulate your rooms against Nevada summer heat and winter cold.

cards.alt: Tan Roman shades with folded fabric panels above a window
cards.title: Roman Shades
cards.text: Soft fabric folds that give bedrooms and living rooms a warm, finished look while still controlling light and privacy.

cards.alt: Remote control operating motorized window blinds
cards.title: Motorized Blinds & Shades
cards.text: Raise and lower at the touch of a button. The answer for tall windows, stairwells and hard-to-reach glass.

steps.heading: How It Works
steps.sub: From first call to finished windows, the process is simple.

items.title: 1. Get a free quote
items.text: Call, text or send the form below. Tell us about your windows and the rooms you want to improve.

items.title: 2. Made to fit
items.text: Your blinds and shades are sized to your windows for a clean, custom fit. No off-the-shelf guesswork.

items.title: 3. Professional installation
items.text: Our team installs every unit and checks its operation before we leave. If anything is not right, tell us and we fix it.

items.title: 4. Enjoy the room
items.text: Better light control, more privacy and a more comfortable home, fitted and finished by one local shop.
